notes.title: Version 1.1.0 "Missed Connections"
notes.notes: [p][url="https://outsiderartisan.net/succubus-stories/CHANGELOG"]Complete changelog.[/url] [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Succubus Stories v1.1.0[/b] – [b]Missed Connections[/b] – [i]2025-09-11 [/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Added a new special romance option! This romance can be accessed by all players regardless of if they’re already in another romance, but the context and outcome of the romance will change subtly based on which romances they did go with. This update also adds some new content to the post-game and preps the game for its Steam release this month![/p][p align="start"]Also included is a new fetish type, new advancement options, new encounter moves, and more![/p]
